1
Initiation & Checklist
Site Supervisor (PTW-001 to PTW-005, PTW-008), Electrician (PTW-006), Blasting In-charge (PTW-007), Lifting Supervisor (PTW-009A/B), or Night Site Supervisor (PTW-010 Handover) fills their respective permit form, statutory checklist & uploads photo.
2
Field Verification
Site Engineer verifies site ground safety & forwards (can Approve or Return; cannot Cancel).
3
Clearances & Domain Approval
Discipline clearances (MEP, P&M, IT, Quality Engineer) followed by Section Head / Tower Incharge review.
4
EHS Safety Endorsement
EHS Safety Manager / Officer conducts final statutory review to activate permit, audit observations, or stop work.

Enterprise Role Authorization & Access

Select an authorized operational role to access the permit governance portal. User permissions, verification gates, and statutory sign-off authority are strictly enforced based on role assignments.

Weekend Protocol ARPL EHS Weekend & Sunday Operations Governance Architecture
Zero Unvetted Work Mandate Strict Time-Window Adherence
1. Saturday Preparation Window

Dedicated Sunday Work (SUN) Tile activates side-by-side with standard PTW. Permits for Sunday activities (PTW-001 to PTW-009) must be prepared in advance on Saturday with valid operational hours strictly scheduled for the immediate next day (Sunday) (08:30–19:30 IST). Night Shift excluded from SUN tile.

2. Sunday Zero-Creation Lockout

No permits can be raised on Sunday. All permit-raising tiles and entry points system-wide are strictly blocked to prevent unvetted ad-hoc weekend risk. All Sunday work must be pre-cleared on Saturday.

3. Sunday Execution & Closure

Pre-authorized permits execute and must be closed and surrendered on Sunday only as per valid scheduled time. Closure on Saturday is strictly prohibited. Certified supervisors execute site restoration, post-work safety checks, and digital sign-off.
